title: Release-data coverage claim
description: What data/releases/products/ claims to cover. A release-cutoff pool is only materialisable when its cutoff date falls inside a claimed-complete window; the validator enforces this so missing coverage is an explicit error, never a silently smaller pool.

known_gaps.description: Products or date ranges known to be missing or under-researched inside the claimed windows. Honest bookkeeping: gaps listed here still count as coverage for materialisation, so anything that would change a pool must be an explicit pool include/exclude instead.
